# Bring PCL's GPU KinectFusion and people-detection modules to CUDA 12.8 (RTX 5090) `/workspace` contains three repositories (each its own git repo): | repo | what it is | |---|---| | `pcl` | The Point Cloud Library at upstream commit `c47198828`. Its GPU stack:

• `gpu/octree`, `gpu/features`, `gpu/surface`
• the applications `gpu/kinfu` (KinectFusion), `gpu/kinfu_large_scale` (KinectFusion with a moving cyclical volume) and `gpu/people` (random-forest body-part detection, including vendored NVIDIA NCV / NPP-staging primitives) | | `kinfu_replay` | A downstream tool that runs KinFu and KinFu large-scale on synthetic depth sequences with known ground truth. It reports poses, TSDF statistics, meshes, extracted clouds and timing, and can run several trackers concurrently (`--concurrent`). | | `people_eval` | A downstream tool that runs the people detector on an RGB-D frame and its variants (`people_eval`, with `--threads` for concurrent detectors), and exercises the NCV / NPP-staging primitives (`ncv_check`). | The lab's new machine has an **RTX 5090 (Blackwell, sm_120)**, which needs **CUDA 12.8** or later, and that is the only toolkit installed (`/usr/local/cuda`). On CUDA 12, PCL's CMake disables `gpu_kinfu`, `gpu_kinfu_large_scale` and `gpu_people` ("uses textures which was removed in CUDA 12"); see upstream issues #5571 and #5995. The code was written for pre-Volta GPUs. **Make these three modules, and everything they depend on, build and run correctly on CUDA 12.8 / sm_120.** The two tools must keep working unchanged. ## Requirements 1. **Builds on CUDA 12.8.** - `pcl` configures and builds with CUDA 12.8 for sm_120, with `gpu_kinfu`, `gpu_kinfu_large_scale` and `gpu_people` enabled by default. - No texture or surface *references* remain anywhere in the GPU modules. That covers integral images (also from unaligned sources), decimation, rectangle std-dev, separable filters, resize and frame interpolation, plus compaction and transpose. - KinFu and KinFu large-scale must track and reconstruct as well as the original, measured against ground truth. Their TSDF volumes, meshes and extracted clouds must agree with the original's to within floating-point noise. 3. **Correct on independent thread scheduling.** - The modernized kernels must not depend on implicit warp-synchronous execution. - `compute-sanitizer` must report nothing on the KinFu, KinFu large-scale, people and NCV workloads with `--tool racecheck`, `--tool synccheck` and `--tool memcheck`. 4. **Safe for concurrent use.** - Several `KinfuTracker`, `kinfuLS::KinfuTracker`, `MarchingCubes` and `PeopleDetector` instances may run at the same time from different host threads. - Every result must then be bitwise identical to running each alone. 5. **Much faster than the original.** The lab moved to this GPU to run these pipelines faster, often several at once. namespace pcl {

class TextureBinder {
public:
  template <class T, enum cudaTextureReadMode readMode>
  TextureBinder(const DeviceArray2D<T>& arr, const struct texture<T, 2, readMode>& tex)
  : texref(&tex)
  {
    cudaChannelFormatDesc desc = cudaCreateChannelDesc<T>();
    cudaSafeCall(
        cudaBindTexture2D(0, tex, arr.ptr(), desc, arr.cols(), arr.rows(), arr.step()));
  }

  template <class T, enum cudaTextureReadMode readMode>
  TextureBinder(const DeviceArray<T>& arr, const struct texture<T, 1, readMode>& tex)
  : texref(&tex)
  {
    cudaChannelFormatDesc desc = cudaCreateChannelDesc<T>();
    cudaSafeCall(cudaBindTexture(0, tex, arr.ptr(), desc, arr.sizeBytes()));
  }

  template <class T, enum cudaTextureReadMode readMode>
  TextureBinder(const PtrStepSz<T>& arr, const struct texture<T, 2, readMode>& tex)
  : texref(&tex)
  {
    cudaChannelFormatDesc desc = cudaCreateChannelDesc<T>();
    cudaSafeCall(
        cudaBindTexture2D(0, tex, arr.data, desc, arr.cols, arr.rows, arr.step));
  }

  template <class T, enum cudaTextureReadMode readMode>
  TextureBinder(const PtrSz<T>& arr, const struct texture<T, 1, readMode>& tex)
  : texref(&tex)
  {
    cudaChannelFormatDesc desc = cudaCreateChannelDesc<T>();
    cudaSafeCall(cudaBindTexture(0, tex, arr.data, desc, arr.size * arr.elemSize()));
  }

  ~TextureBinder() { cudaSafeCall(cudaUnbindTexture(texref)); }

private:
  const struct textureReference* texref;
};

namespace pcl

    __device__ __forceinline__ int findRoot(const PtrStepSz<int>& comps, int label)
    {                       
        for(;;)
        {
          int y = label / comps.cols;
          int x = label - y * comps.cols;

          int parent = comps.ptr(y)[x];

          if (label == parent)
              break;

          label = parent;          
        }
        return label;
    }

    texture<unsigned char, 2, cudaReadModeElementType> edgesTex;
    
    struct TilesMerge
    {           
      int tileSizeX;
      int tileSizeY;
      int tilesNumX;
      int tilesNumY;

      mutable PtrStepSz<int> comps;

      __device__ __forceinline__ void 
      unionF(int l1, int l2, bool& changed) const
      {
        int r1 = findRoot(comps, l1);
        int r2 = findRoot(comps, l2);
        
        if (r1 != r2)
        {          
          int mi = min(r1, r2);
          int ma = max(r1, r2);

          int y = ma / comps.cols;
          int x = ma - y * comps.cols;
          atomicMin(&comps.ptr(y)[x], mi);
          changed = true;
        }        
      } 
      
      __device__ __forceinline__ void
      operator()() const
      {
        int tid = Block::flattenedThreadId();
        int stride = Block::stride();
                
        int xbeg = blockIdx.x * tilesNumX * tileSizeX;
        int xend = xbeg + tilesNumX * tileSizeX;

        int ybeg = blockIdx.y * tilesNumY * tileSizeY;
        int yend = ybeg + tilesNumY * tileSizeY;

        int tasksH = (tilesNumY - 1) * (xend - xbeg);
        int tasksV = (tilesNumX - 1) * (yend - ybeg);

        int total = tasksH + tasksV;
        
        bool changed;
        do
        {           
          changed = false;

          for( int task_index = tid; task_index < total; task_index += stride)
            if (task_index < tasksH)
            {
              int indexH = task_index;

              int row = indexH / (xend - xbeg);
              int col = indexH - row * (xend - xbeg);

              int y = ybeg + (row + 1) * tileSizeY;
              int x = xbeg + col;

              int e = tex2D(edgesTex, x, y);
              if (e & Edges::UP)
              {
                int lc = comps.ptr(y  )[x];
                int lu = comps.ptr(y-1)[x];
                unionF(lc, lu, changed);
              }
            }
            else
            {
              int indexV = task_index - tasksH;

              int col = indexV / (yend - ybeg);
              int row = indexV - col * (yend - ybeg);

              int x = xbeg + (col + 1) * tileSizeX;
              int y = ybeg + row;
              
              int e = tex2D(edgesTex, x, y);
              if (e & Edges::LEFT)
              {
                int lc = comps.ptr(y)[x  ];
                int ll = comps.ptr(y)[x-1];
                unionF(lc, ll, changed);
              }                                                                                 
            }                   
        }
        while(__syncthreads_or(changed));
      }

    };

    __global__ void mergeKernel(const TilesMerge tm) { tm(); }        
  }

Cloud::Ptr variant(const Cloud& base, const std::string& v) {
  Cloud::Ptr c(new Cloud(base));
  const int W = (int)base.width, H = (int)base.height;
  if (v == "base") return c;
  if (v == "mirror") {
    for (int y = 0; y < H; ++y)
      for (int x = 0; x < W; ++x) {
        auto p = base.at(W - 1 - x, y);
        p.x = -p.x;
        c->at(x, y) = p;
      }
  } else if (v == "farther") {
    for (auto& p : c->points) if (std::isfinite(p.z)) { p.x *= 1.25f; p.y *= 1.25f; p.z *= 1.25f; p.z += 0.0f; }
  } else if (v == "noise") {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < c->points.size(); ++i) {
      auto& p = c->points[i];
      if (!std::isfinite(p.z)) continue;
      float u = (hash32((std::uint32_t)i * 2654435761U) + 0.5f) / 4294967296.f - 0.5f;
      float s = 1.f + 0.012f * u;
      p.x *= s; p.y *= s; p.z *= s;
    }
  } else if (v == "holes") {
    for (int y = 120; y < 300; ++y)
      for (int x = 250; x < 330; ++x) {
        auto& p = c->at(x, y);
        p.x = p.y = p.z = std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN();
      }
  } else if (v.rfind("jitter-", 0) == 0) {
    // jitter-<seed>: seeded per-point scale noise, a seeded hole and a one-pixel shift
    const std::uint32_t seed = (std::uint32_t)std::stoul(v.substr(7));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < c->points.size(); ++i) {
      auto& p = c->points[i];
      if (!std::isfinite(p.z)) continue;
      float u = (hash32((std::uint32_t)i * 2654435761U ^ seed * 0x9e3779b1U) + 0.5f) / 4294967296.f - 0.5f;
      float s = 1.f + 0.02f * u;
      p.x *= s; p.y *= s; p.z *= s;
    }
    const int hx = 40 + (int)(hash32(seed) % 480), hy = 40 + (int)(hash32(seed + 1) % 320);
    for (int y = hy; y < hy + 60; ++y)
      for (int x = hx; x < hx + 70; ++x) {
        auto& p = c->at(x, y);
        p.x = p.y = p.z = std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN();
      }
    if (seed & 1) {
      Cloud tmp(*c);
      for (int y = 0; y < H; ++y)
        for (int x = 1; x < W; ++x) c->at(x, y) = tmp.at(x - 1, y);
    }
  } else {
    throw std::runtime_error("unknown variant " + v);
  }
  return c;
}

// Runs every variant of the frame through one detector; writes OUT/<variant>.labels and OUT/result.json.
int run_detector(const Cloud& base, const std::string& trees, const std::string& out, const std::vector<std::string>& vars, int repeat) {
  std::vector<std::string> names = {trees + "/tree_20_1.txt", trees + "/tree_20_2.txt", trees + "/tree_20_3.txt"};
  pcl::gpu::people::RDFBodyPartsDetector::Ptr rdf(new pcl::gpu::people::RDFBodyPartsDetector(names));
  pcl::gpu::people::PeopleDetector det;
  det.rdf_detector_ = rdf;
  std::ofstream js(out + "/result.json");
  js << "{";
  for (size_t vi = 0; vi < vars.size(); ++vi) {
    Cloud::Ptr c = variant(base, vars[vi]);
    int ret = -1;
    std::vector<double> ms;
    for (int r = 0; r < repeat; ++r) {
      cudaDeviceSynchronize();
      auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
      ret = det.process(c);
      cudaDeviceSynchronize();
      ms.push_back(std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count());
    }
    std::sort(ms.begin(), ms.end());
    std::vector<unsigned char> labels;
    int cols;
    rdf->getLabels().download(labels, cols);
    std::ofstream lf(out + "/" + vars[vi] + ".labels", std::ios::binary);
    lf.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(labels.data()), labels.size());
    std::map<int, long> hist;
    for (auto l : labels) hist[l]++;
    js << (vi ? ", " : "") << "\"" << vars[vi] << "\": {\"return\": " << ret << ", \"ms_median\": " << ms[ms.size() / 2]
       << ", \"histogram\": {";
    bool first = true;
    for (auto& kv : hist) {
      js << (first ? "" : ", ") << "\"" << kv.first << "\": " << kv.second;
      first = false;
    }
    js << "}}";
  }

  return 0;
}

//Almost the same as naive scan1Inclusive, but doesn't need __syncthreads()
//assuming size <= WARP_SIZE and size is power of 2
template <class T>
inline __device__ T warpScanInclusive(T idata, volatile T *s_Data)
{
    Ncv32u pos = 2 * threadIdx.x - (threadIdx.x & (K_WARP_SIZE - 1));
    s_Data[pos] = 0;
    pos += K_WARP_SIZE;
    s_Data[pos] = idata;

    //for(Ncv32u offset = 1; offset < K_WARP_SIZE; offset <<= 1)
    //{
    //    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - offset];
    //}

    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 1];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 2];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 4];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 8];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 16];

    return s_Data[pos];
}


template <class T>
inline __device__ T warpScanExclusive(T idata, volatile T *s_Data)
{
    return warpScanInclusive(idata, s_Data) - idata;
}


template <class T, Ncv32u tiNumScanThreads>
inline __device__ T blockScanInclusive(T idata, volatile T *s_Data)
{
    if (tiNumScanThreads > K_WARP_SIZE)
    {
        //Bottom-level inclusive warp scan
        T warpResult = warpScanInclusive(idata, s_Data);

        //Save top elements of each warp for exclusive warp scan
        //sync to wait for warp scans to complete (because s_Data is being overwritten)
        __syncthreads();
        if( (threadIdx.x & (K_WARP_SIZE - 1)) == (K_WARP_SIZE - 1) )
        {
            s_Data[threadIdx.x >> K_LOG2_WARP_SIZE] = warpResult;
        }

        //wait for warp scans to complete
        __syncthreads();

        if( threadIdx.x < (tiNumScanThreads / K_WARP_SIZE) )
        {
            //grab top warp elements
            T val = s_Data[threadIdx.x];
            //calculate exclusive scan and write back to shared memory
            s_Data[threadIdx.x] = warpScanExclusive(val, s_Data);
        }

        //return updated warp scans with exclusive scan results
        __syncthreads();
        return warpResult + s_Data[threadIdx.x >> K_LOG2_WARP_SIZE];
    }
    else
    {
        return warpScanInclusive(idata, s_Data);
    }
}

   382	    struct TilesMerge
   383	    {           
   384	      int tileSizeX;
   385	      int tileSizeY;
   386	      int tilesNumX;
   387	      int tilesNumY;
   388	
   389	      mutable PtrStepSz<int> comps;

   391	      __device__ __forceinline__ void 
   392	      unionF(int l1, int l2, bool& changed) const
   393	      {
   394	        int r1 = findRoot(comps, l1);
   395	        int r2 = findRoot(comps, l2);
   396	        
   397	        if (r1 != r2)
   398	        {          
   399	          int mi = min(r1, r2);
   400	          int ma = max(r1, r2);
   401	
   402	          int y = ma / comps.cols;
   403	          int x = ma - y * comps.cols;
   404	          atomicMin(&comps.ptr(y)[x], mi);
   405	          changed = true;
   406	        }        
   407	      } 
   408	      
   409	      __device__ __forceinline__ void
   410	      operator()() const
   411	      {
   412	        int tid = Block::flattenedThreadId();
   413	        int stride = Block::stride();
   414	                
   415	        int xbeg = blockIdx.x * tilesNumX * tileSizeX;
   416	        int xend = xbeg + tilesNumX * tileSizeX;
   417	
   418	        int ybeg = blockIdx.y * tilesNumY * tileSizeY;
   419	        int yend = ybeg + tilesNumY * tileSizeY;
   420	
   421	        int tasksH = (tilesNumY - 1) * (xend - xbeg);
   422	        int tasksV = (tilesNumX - 1) * (yend - ybeg);
   423	
   424	        int total = tasksH + tasksV;
   425	        
   426	        bool changed;
   427	        do
   428	        {           
   429	          changed = false;
   430	
   431	          for( int task_index = tid; task_index < total; task_index += stride)
   432	            if (task_index < tasksH)
   433	            {
   434	              int indexH = task_index;
   435	
   436	              int row = indexH / (xend - xbeg);
   437	              int col = indexH - row * (xend - xbeg);
   438	
   439	              int y = ybeg + (row + 1) * tileSizeY;
   440	              int x = xbeg + col;
   441	
   442	              int e = tex2D(edgesTex, x, y);
   443	              if (e & Edges::UP)
   444	              {
   445	                int lc = comps.ptr(y  )[x];
   446	                int lu = comps.ptr(y-1)[x];
   447	                unionF(lc, lu, changed);
   448	              }
   449	            }
   450	            else
   451	            {
   452	              int indexV = task_index - tasksH;
   453	
   454	              int col = indexV / (yend - ybeg);
   455	              int row = indexV - col * (yend - ybeg);
   456	
   457	              int x = xbeg + (col + 1) * tileSizeX;
   458	              int y = ybeg + row;
   459	              
   460	              int e = tex2D(edgesTex, x, y);
   461	              if (e & Edges::LEFT)
   462	              {
   463	                int lc = comps.ptr(y)[x  ];
   464	                int ll = comps.ptr(y)[x-1];
   465	                unionF(lc, ll, changed);
   466	              }                                                                                 
   467	            }
